deal.name: CuspAI
deal.lead_investors: Kleiner Perkins(Joshua Coyne), New Enterprise Associates(Lila Tretikov)

subcategories.label: Lead tier
subcategories.finding: NEA and Kleiner Perkins are both Tier 1 firms [7]

subcategories.label: New vs re-up
subcategories.finding: NEA re-upped (led Series A [1]); Kleiner Perkins is genuinely new money [2]

subcategories.label: Stage fit
subcategories.finding: Series B primary, up round, $445M at $2.53B post-money [1]

subcategories.label: Domain-strategic
subcategories.finding: Both leads are traditional financial VCs, no category asymmetry

subcategories.label: Lead conviction
subcategories.finding: Named partners Coyne (KP) and Tretikov (NEA) have strong track records [7][8]

subcategories.label: Institutional momentum
subcategories.finding: NEA, Temasek, Prosus, Basis Set, Northzone all followed on from prior rounds [1]

subcategories.label: Existing Tier 1
subcategories.finding: Sequoia and Lightspeed (Tier 1+) held pre-round stakes since Seed [1]

subcategories.label: Timing/motivation
subcategories.finding: Valuation went ~$520M to $2.6B in under a year, oversubscribed [4][10]

params.evidence: Co-lead splits ID8's core signal: NEA re-ups, Kleiner Perkins is genuine new money; both are large, uncapacity-constrained funds, not forced sellers of access.

subcategories.label: Prior exit
subcategories.finding: Edwards co-founded CQC, merged into Quantinuum, now leading quantum computing firm [5]

subcategories.label: Domain authority
subcategories.finding: Edwards: chemistry PhD; Welling: AI4Science research, not materials-specific pre-founding [6]

subcategories.label: Team complement
subcategories.finding: CEO (commercial), CTO (AI), CSO Walsh (materials science, Imperial) cover functions [12]

subcategories.label: Recruiting power (as in team growth)
subcategories.finding: Grew 3 to 100+ staff in 2 years; hired Hinton, LeCun [9]

subcategories.label: Public presence
subcategories.finding: Press profiles (GBx, NEA, Imperial) plus academic/conference visibility for founders [5][6][12]

subcategories.label: Integrity
subcategories.finding: No red flags across CQC/Quantinuum, Imperial, NEA, press histories

params.evidence: Founders bring a genuine prior exit (Quantinuum) and elite AI pedigree, complemented by a materials-science CSO hire; recruiting and public credibility are exceptionally strong.

subcategories.label: Ownership of models
subcategories.finding: Proprietary generative + physics-based models built by VAE co-inventor Welling [6]

subcategories.label: Data flywheel / Recurssion
subcategories.finding: 45+ partner Foundry feeds lab-validation data back into models [3][11]

params.evidence: Genuinely structural AI: proprietary architecture from a top ML researcher, reinforced by a named-partner data loop, though compounding improvement isn't yet quantified publicly.

subcategories.label: Just assume they are good (unless there's something public)
subcategories.finding: No public ID8-specific terms found; assume standard 0/0/10 absent signal

params.evidence: No adverse public signal on carry, fees, or SPV structure for this round; standard ID8 terms assumed by default, not independently confirmed.

subcategories.label: Revenue/growth
subcategories.finding: [ESTIMATED] $3.8-7.5M ARR (3rd-party); below $25M bar despite 20x contract growth [13][14]

subcategories.label: NDR
subcategories.finding: Not disclosed; no subscription NDR metric found or estimable

subcategories.label: Margins/unit econ
subcategories.finding: Gross margin/unit economics not disclosed; no usable estimate exists

subcategories.label: Burn/runway
subcategories.finding: Burn not disclosed; 4Q2025 cash ($28.5M) looked low vs. capital raised

subcategories.label: Customer concentration
subcategories.finding: Multi-industry partners (Nvidia, Meta, Samsung, Hyundai, ASML, Kemira) suggest diversification [3][11]

subcategories.label: Pref stack
subcategories.finding: Prior rounds show senior participating preferred; Series B terms undisclosed

subcategories.label: Moat durability
subcategories.finding: 45+ enterprise Foundry partners plus Hinton/LeCun advisors form real moat [3][11]

subcategories.label: Market/TAM
subcategories.finding: Materials R&D spans semis, batteries, carbon capture, clean energy -- venture-scale

subcategories.label: Valuation vs comps
subcategories.finding: Implied 347-684x revenue vs. XtalPi's public 26.8x multiple -- rich [13][16]

subcategories.label: Sector risk
subcategories.finding: DeepMind/Microsoft open materials-gen models compete; physical-synthesis partnerships differentiate [15][17]

params.evidence: No confirmed revenue; a thin third-party ARR estimate implies a rich multiple, but named enterprise partnerships and TAM breadth are genuinely strong offsetting signals.

subcategories.label: Entry multiple
subcategories.finding: Rich vs. estimated revenue and nascent-sector comps; hard to justify confidently [13][16]

subcategories.label: Base-case MOIC
subcategories.finding: 6x needs ~$15B+ exit; largest public comp (XtalPi) is $4B [16]

subcategories.label: Exit path
subcategories.finding: XtalPi's public listing is a sector precedent; strategic acquirers among partners [16]

subcategories.label: Dilution
subcategories.finding: No future-round dilution modeling available at this stage of screen

subcategories.label: Time to liquidity
subcategories.finding: Series B, early; liquidity likely 5+ years out, unmodeled precisely

subcategories.label: Downside protection
subcategories.finding: No disclosed downside terms for a hypothetical ID8 co-invest structure

subcategories.label: Exit multiples
subcategories.finding: XtalPi is the closest comp but differs (pharma/robotics hybrid, China) [16]

subcategories.label: Secondary demand
subcategories.finding: No Setter 30 or Forge/Caplight listing found; too new to trade

params.evidence: Base-case 6x is a stretch at this entry: sector's only public comp trades far smaller; some exit optionality exists via strategics and an IPO precedent.

model_output.rationale: CuspAI mostly aligns with ID8's thesis: genuine new-money Tier 1 (Kleiner Perkins) co-leads alongside a verified NEA re-up, and AI is structurally the moat, not a feature. But undisclosed revenue and a fast, rich re-rating temper conviction on return potential.
